As a system user

I want to be able to create and manage orders for service

So that I have possibility to manage relationships and tasks more easily for customers requesting the same type of services without a contract or individually under specific conditions

 

Acceptance criteria:

  1. Creating an order for a service is possible from Service Order's listing page by clicking on a 'Plus' button

  2. Clicking on a Plus button will open service order's creation page

  3. Check system user permissions to be able to create a new order for a service

    1. Permission - Create a Service Order

    2. Enable Plus button when user has permission

    3. Disabled Plus button when user doesn't have permission

  4. Default state of a Service Order's creation page contains two individual tabs:

    1. Basic Parameters tab

    2. Service Parameters tab

  5. 'Issue a proforma invoice' will be active after saving the service order

  6. 'Issue an invoice' will be active after creating a proforma invoice only if Payment Term is filled

 

Basic Parameters tab contains fields:

  1. Order number

    1. Always disabled

    2. Empty

    3. Text field

    4. Order number should be unique

      1. Is automatically generated by the system after creating order; Orders in the system are automatically numbered with a prefix (ORES) and a unique 10-digit number representing YYMMXXXXXX, where XXXXXX is the serial number of the order for the month. E.g. if first order is generated in 1st May 2023 order number will look like this: 2305000001. Prefixes should be hardcoded in the system with following format: ORES

    5. For contracts and orders counter should each month should counter must be reset in each month

      1. Counter in contracts (product contract, service contract) should be the same

        Counter in orders (service order, goods order) should be the same

  2. Creation date

    1. After saving order, date should be automatically filled based on the time of the order completion

    2. Date picker

    3. Always disabled

    4. Format: DD.MM.YYYY

    5. Is automatically generated by the system after creating the order

  3. Order status

    1. Mandatory

      1. Single select dropdown with hardcoded values. In creation only two statuses are visible:

        1. Requested

        2. Confirmed

    2. List of all service order statuses (More details are described in edit story):

      1. Requested

      2. Confirmed

      3. Awaiting payment

      4. Paid

      5. In execution

      6. Completed

      7. Refused

  4. Order's status Modify date

    1. After changing order's status, date should be automatically saved filled baes on the time of the order's editing

      1. If the order status is changed automatically, this modify date should be also updated

      2. Manual entering the date should also be saved.

        1. If this date is added manually, then system shouldn't rewrite it automatically after saving

        2. Date picker

        3. Always enabled

        4. Format: DD.MM.YYYY

        5. If the sub-status is changed even when the main status remain the same, the modify date should be updated with the date of change of the sub-status
